description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Rograkh.
Choose to have Rograkh return to the command zone from your graveyard.
Myth Unbound and Copy Enchantment trigger, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Cast Rograkh from the command zone by paying {0} due to the cost reductions from Myth Unbound and Copy Enchantment.
Repeat.

uses.name: Copy Enchantment
uses.cardState: as a copy of Myth Unbound
